reference.dataset: Multi-Sensor and MTConnect (MSM) dataset of metal cutting anomaly in milling

audio.mic_role: s0 = airborne microphone near the cutting zone
audio.gain_policy: Level is preserved (no loudness normalization in the stored file). Per-session relative normalization happens later at feature time, so that clipping and loudness stay measurable.
audio.upsampled_policy: If the native sample rate is below 48000 Hz the file is upsampled for format compatibility and flagged bandlimited=true; content above native Nyquist must not be treated as signal.

label_csv.row_meaning: One row = one cutting segment (lab: one tool path; production: one annotated interval). Time not covered by any row is non-cutting, not normal.

columns.name: start
columns.description: Segment start, seconds from the session sync zero

columns.name: end
columns.description: Segment end, seconds from the session sync zero

columns.name: label
columns.description: 0 normal stable cutting; 1 abnormal cutting that should be stopped; 2 pre-existing tool defect but cutting itself normal (a defective tool with anomalous cutting is 1)

columns.name: direction
columns.description: UP = up-milling (conventional), DOWN = down-milling (climb); empty if unknown

columns.name: F
columns.description: Feed rate (note: mm per second, not mm/min)

columns.name: Tool
columns.description: Tool code; a trailing * marks an intentionally defective tool. Provenance-sensitive: never a model input

label_values.-1: not_mappable (kept only in the events table, never written to label.csv)

unlabeled_cutting_csv.written_when: Only when the session has at least one event with msm_label=-1 whose cut_state is cutting (the source or the approver could not decide the label) or unknown (no label rule, or a rule saying the cut state is unknown). Absent otherwise, so MSM-layout sessions never have it. cut_state=non_cutting never gets a row (it stays a gap).
unlabeled_cutting_csv.meaning: Each row is a span without an MSM label. It is not a label.csv row (label.csv keeps labels 0/1/2 only) and it is not non-cutting time. build_db.py stores cut_state exactly as given (cutting or unknown) with labels.label_std=-1 and does not count it as a non-cutting gap.
unlabeled_cutting_csv.validation: start/end finite numbers, start < end, end <= audio duration + 0.05 s, cut_state in {cutting, unknown}, no overlap with a label.csv row or another sidecar row; build_db.py and validate.py both reject a violating file (build_db writes no database).
unlabeled_cutting_csv.added: 2026-10-16 Sprint 3 (MAJOR-2; cut_state column and validation added in G5 for E2-6/E2-1/E2-2); label.csv columns, audio format and label semantics unchanged

event_extension.description: Columns added in the normalized events table on top of label.csv

columns.name: label_native
columns.description: Original label text or value from the source

columns.name: anomaly_type
columns.description: e.g. chatter, tool_breakage, tool_wear, clamp_failure; null if unknown

columns.name: clip_ratio
columns.description: Fraction of native samples at full scale inside the event

context_unified.description: Unified controller columns. Source column names differ per machine; mapping is per source.

provenance_only.description: Fields that can leak the experiment design. Stored in a separate provenance table, never exposed to models or the agent's analysis tools.

unit_conversions.note: needs tool diameter: N = 1000 * v / (pi * D)
